title: Warm Crispy Peruvian Potatoes Papa Rellena
description: A peppery and crispy Peruvian dish featuring dehydrated potatoes and orange, perfect for a post-workout snack, this recipe is gluten-free-friendly and formed into papa rellena
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dehydrate the diced potatoes in the oven for 30 minutes to remove excess moisture.
In a large bowl, mix together the dehydrated potatoes, orange juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg and set aside.
In another bowl, place the gluten-free flour.
Take a handful of the potato mixture and shape into a ball, then flatten slightly into a patty shape.
Dip the patty into the beaten egg, then coat in the gluten-free flour.
Repeat the process with the remaining potato mixture.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the patties until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the warm crispy Peruvian potatoes papa rellena immediately.
